steps.text: Planning who does what

This is a diagnosis of a sign-up drop, so the desks each take one question about the same drop: the analyst finds which step and day moved, the on-call engineer finds the crash behind it, the release manager checks what shipped and what is stuck in review, the tech lead (after the on-call engineer) maps what else the broken screen takes down, and the librarian checks prior decisions. Growth marketing is left out because no ad change should be proposed before the cause is confirmed.

Find which sign-up step dropped and on which day the drop started, comparing the week of 7 October with the weeks before it, to confirm the drop lines up with the release that reached everyone on 7 October.
Find what crashed or errored on the sign-up screen and the phone-number field since 7 October, including the error count, first-seen date and current status.
Find what shipped around 7 October and what is still stuck in store review, covering Android 2.8.0 and 2.8.1 and iPhone 2.8.1, with each release's current status.
Find any earlier decision or lesson about the phone-number box, the country-code picker or the 2.8.0 release, and who made it.

**The sign-up screen crash is real and still open.** "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'country') in PhoneInput" was first seen 2026-10-07, last seen 2026-10-15, and is marked fatal and unresolved [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]].

- Size: on 2026-10-15 it logged 406 error events and hit 218 people [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]]. The 406 and 218 are for that one day only. A total since 7 Oct is not recorded.
- Cause: version 2.8.0 swapped the plain phone box for a field that picks the country code itself, rolled out on Android on 7 Oct [[document:release-notes-2-8-0]]. The hotfix says it crashes when no country is detected [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]].
- Fix status: 2.8.1 was built 13 Oct and sent to the App Store that day [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]]. As of 2026-10-15, iPhone is waiting for review and Android is built but waiting for sign-off [[document:store-status]].
- Owner: Farhan, Android engineer, owns the sign-up screens [[person:farhan]]. The decision was to ship the hotfix, not roll back [[decision:014-hotfix-not-rollback]].

**The drop is at the phone-number step, and it started on 7 October, the day the release reached everyone.** Fewer people did not arrive; the same people arrived and could not get past that box.

- Top of the flow held: sign-up screen views were 397 on 2026-09-28 and 392 on 2026-10-15 [[feature:seekers-signup-sign-up-screen-viewed]].
- Phone number entered stepped down from about 294 a day to about 60 a day from 2026-10-07 [[feature:seekers-signup-phone-number-entered]].
- Later steps fell the same day, so they are knock-on effects: OTP verified from about 245 to about 51 [[feature:seekers-signup-otp-verified]], first application from about 122 to about 26 [[feature:seekers-signup-first-application]].
- New accounts went from about 238 a day to about 51 from 2026-10-07 [[business:shiftly]]. Phone sign-ups fell from about 199 to about 11 a day [[channel:app]]. Google sign-ups stayed at 40 to 45 a day [[channel:app]].
- The earlier crash record ties this to the new phone-number field in version 2.8.0, with the 2.8.1 fix approved and open [[turn:2026-10-16-659804c1]]. Google Analytics is not connected, so I used the daily sign-up export (as of 2026-10-15) [[document:funnel-daily]].
Reviewing Kabir's finding

**Finding:** The phone-number box came in with version 2.8.0. Rhea decided on 10 October 2026 to ship a fix (2.8.1) instead of rolling 2.8.0 back. [[decision:014-hotfix-not-rollback]]

- 2.8.0 replaced the plain phone box on the sign-up screen with a field that picks the country code by itself. It went to everyone on Android on 7 October. [[document:release-notes-2-8-0]] [[page:screen/app/auth/sign-up]]
- Rollback was ruled out because it would also remove the new job feed, which shipped in the same release. [[decision:014-hotfix-not-rollback]] [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-0]]
- The fix, 2.8.1, targets the crash when no country is detected. It was built on 13 October. As of 2026-10-15, iPhone was waiting for App Store review and Android was waiting for sign-off. [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]] [[document:store-status]]
- Owner: ADR 014 names Farhan; the decision itself is recorded under Rhea. Who chose the 2.8.0 change is not recorded. [[document:adr-014]] [[person:farhan]] [[person:founder]]

Revising after review

Version 2.8.0 (Android, 7 October) lines up with the sign-up drop. Its fix, 2.8.1, is not live on either store yet: Android is waiting for sign-off and iPhone is waiting for Apple review, as of 2026-10-15 [[document:store-status]].

- Android 2.8.0 went to everyone on 7 October. It added the new phone number field on sign-up [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-0]] [[document:release-notes-2-8-0]].
- Crash-free sessions fell from 99.4% to 92.2% after that build [[task:fix-insight-tech-release-health-event-release-shiftly-2-8-0-a378aa]]. The app's daily reading was 92.45% on 2026-10-15 [[obs:crash_free_sessions_daily_pct:channel:app:2026-10-15]].
- Android 2.8.1 (the fix) was built 13 October and is waiting for sign-off. It is not released [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-1]].
- iPhone 2.8.1 was sent to Apple on 13 October and had waited 2 days as of 2026-10-15 [[event:ios-version-2-8-1]] [[channel:app-ios]].
- Store status of iPhone 2.8.0: not recorded. On 10 October the team chose to ship a fix rather than roll back, to keep the new job feed [[decision:014-hotfix-not-rollback]] [[document:adr-014]].

**The crash reaches 10 things in total: 2 one step away, 8 more up to four steps away.** (Records as of 2026-10-15.)

**One step away (what a simple look shows):**
- The Shiftly app [[channel:app]] and the sign-up screen with the phone-number field [[page:screen/app/auth/sign-up]].

**Two to four steps away (easy to miss):**
- Two steps: the Pune Meta ads send people to this screen [[campaign:meta-seekers-pune]] (ad figures are sample numbers). The steps "Sign-up screen viewed" [[feature:seekers-signup-sign-up-screen-viewed]], "Phone number entered" [[feature:seekers-signup-phone-number-entered]] and "App opened" [[feature:seekers-signup-app-opened]] also sit here.
- Three steps: "OTP verified" [[feature:seekers-signup-otp-verified]], which needs the phone number first.
- Four steps: Job-alert SMS [[feature:job-alert-sms]], Referral invites [[feature:referral-invites]] and Profile completed [[feature:seekers-signup-profile-completed]] all need OTP verified.

Owners for these are not recorded in this check. The map is thin, so this is what is recorded, not everything that could break.
Reviewing Arjun's finding

Sign-ups dropped at the phone-number step, starting 2026-10-07, the day 2.8.0 reached everyone on Android. The same people arrived and could not get past that box.

- Top of flow held: sign-up screen views were 397 on 2026-09-28 and 392 on 2026-10-15 [[feature:seekers-signup-sign-up-screen-viewed]].
- Phone number entered fell from about 294 a day to about 60 from 2026-10-07 [[feature:seekers-signup-phone-number-entered]].
- Knock-on: OTP verified about 245 to 51 [[feature:seekers-signup-otp-verified]]; first application about 122 to 26 [[feature:seekers-signup-first-application]].
- New accounts about 238 to 51 a day [[business:shiftly]]. Phone sign-ups about 199 to 11; Google held at 40 to 45 a day [[channel:app]].
- Likely cause: the new phone field in 2.8.0 [[turn:2026-10-16-659804c1]]. The export has no device split, so "Android" comes from release notes. No Google Analytics; used the export (as of 2026-10-15) [[document:funnel-daily]].

What to do: push two things today. iOS 2.8.1 has waited for App Store review since 2026-10-13. Android 2.8.1 waits for sign-off; approve it first [[document:store-status]].

run.answer:
Sign-ups dropped because the new phone-number box crashes the sign-up screen. It arrived in version 2.8.0, which reached everyone on Android on 7 October [[event:release-shiftly-2-8-0]]. This is proven: the crash is on record as first seen 7 October, on that screen [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]]. The records have no device split, so "Android" comes from the release notes.

How it played out (data as of 2026-10-15):
- Sign-up screen views held: 397 on 2026-09-28 and 392 on 2026-10-15 [[feature:seekers-signup-sign-up-screen-viewed]]. The same people arrived.
- Phone number entered fell from about 294 a day to about 60 from 2026-10-07 [[feature:seekers-signup-phone-number-entered]].
- New accounts fell from about 238 to 51 a day [[business:shiftly]]. Phone sign-ups went from about 199 to 11, while Google sign-ups held at 40 to 45 a day [[channel:app]].
- The crash is "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'country')" in the phone field. On 2026-10-15 it logged 406 error events and hit 218 people. That is one day only; a total since 7 October is not recorded [[event:sentry-issue-shiftly-41]].
- Farhan, Android engineer, owns the sign-up screen [[person:farhan]].

What else it hits (from the tech check, as of 2026-10-15):
- Two steps away: the Pune Meta ads (sample numbers) send people to this screen [[campaign:meta-seekers-pune]].
- Three steps away: OTP verified fell from about 245 to 51 [[feature:seekers-signup-otp-verified]]. First application fell from about 122 to 26 [[feature:seekers-signup-first-application]].
- Four steps away, easy to miss: job-alert SMS [[feature:job-alert-sms]], referral invites [[feature:referral-invites]] and profile completed [[feature:seekers-signup-profile-completed]].

Where it stands:
- On 10 October you chose to ship a fix, not roll back. A rollback would also remove the new job feed [[decision:014-hotfix-not-rollback]].
- The fix, 2.8.1, was built on 13 October [[document:release-notes-2-8-1]]. Android is waiting for sign-off. iPhone has waited for App Store review since 13 October [[document:store-status]].
- Earlier today you approved two fix tasks. Both are open: [[task:fix-insight-tech-sentry-hot-issue-event-sentry-issue-shiftly-41-fb41b5]] and [[task:fix-turn-2026-10-16-659804c1-1]]. You rejected the first user message. Another card to ship Android 2.8.1 and get iPhone through review is still waiting for your OK [[recommendation:fix-sign-up-crash-ship-android-2-8-1-and-get-iphone-2-8-1-through-review]].

Not recorded: who chose the 2.8.0 phone-field change, and the iPhone 2.8.0 store status.

I drafted two new items, both waiting for your OK:
- A fix task for Farhan with these numbers and dates.
- A two-line message to affected users, to send only once 2.8.1 is live on both stores, as you asked: "Sign-up is fixed in the latest update. Please update the Shiftly app and try again."

An idea for you to decide: cap or pause the Pune ads until 2.8.1 is live, so you don't pay to send people to a crashing screen.

Next action (under two minutes): approve the open card for Android 2.8.1 so sign-off happens today.
